title: TOEIC Part 7 — 단일 지문
subtitle: Set 23 · 비즈니스 이메일

body: Thank you all for the productive workshop yesterday. As discussed, we will be moving forward with the "Bright Mornings" campaign as our Q3 priority. Below is a summary of the immediate next steps:
1. Hannah will finalize the creative brief by Friday, May 29.
2. James, please coordinate with the external agency to confirm the photo-shoot schedule. We are aiming for the week of June 8.
3. The media buy budget has been approved at $48,000 — a 12% increase from Q2.
I would also like to remind everyone that **the launch date has been moved up by one week** to accommodate the regional sales conference. Please update your project plans accordingly.
If you anticipate any blockers, please reach out to me directly before Thursday's stand-up. I appreciate your continued effort and flexibility.
passage.subject: Q3 Campaign Kickoff — Action Items

faq: "moved up by one week"을 한국어로 풀어주세요
Daniel Park이 가장 강조한 메시지는 무엇인가요?

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.text: To announce a new hire in the marketing team
To outline next steps for an upcoming campaign
To request approval for a budget increase
To reschedule a regional sales conference

items.explanation: 정답은 (B)예요. 이메일 첫 문단의 "moving forward with the campaign as our Q3 priority"와 본문 1-3번 액션 아이템이 핵심 단서예요. 캠페인의 다음 단계를 정리한 이메일이에요.

items.stem: According to the email, what is true about the launch date?

options.text: It has been postponed by one week
It is scheduled for the week of June 8
It has been moved one week earlier
It will be decided during Thursday's stand-up

items.explanation: "the launch date has been moved up by one week"의 move up은 "앞당기다"라는 뜻이에요. (C) one week earlier가 정답.

items.stem: The word "blockers" in paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to —
items.explanation: blockers는 IT/비즈니스 영어에서 "진행을 가로막는 장애물"을 뜻해요. 가장 가까운 동의어는 (B) obstacles.

title: TOEIC Part 7 — 단일 지문
subtitle: Set 24 · 공지 및 안내문

body: Please be advised that **Elevator B in the North Tower will be taken out of service from Thursday, May 28 (7:00 AM) through Friday, May 29 (6:00 PM)** for scheduled hydraulic maintenance.

During this period, Elevator A and the stairwells on both the East and West sides of the building will remain fully operational. We ask all staff to plan accordingly and allow extra travel time between floors.
Employees who require mobility assistance are requested to contact Facilities Management at ext. 4400 by Wednesday afternoon so that appropriate arrangements can be made.
The maintenance is expected to be completed by Friday evening. However, if additional work is required, we will provide an updated timeline no later than Friday at noon.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
passage.subject: Building Maintenance — Elevator Out of Service (May 28–29)

faq: 이 공지에서 직원이 해야 할 일을 정리해주세요

items.stem: What is the purpose of this notice?

options.text: To announce the construction of a new elevator
To inform staff about temporary elevator unavailability
To request volunteers for building maintenance
To introduce new building safety procedures

items.explanation: 정답은 (B)예요. 공지 제목과 첫 문단 "Elevator B … will be taken out of service"가 핵심 단서예요. 엘리베이터의 임시 운행 중단을 알리는 공지예요.

items.stem: According to the notice, what should employees needing assistance do?

options.text: Use the stairwells on the West side only
Wait for further instructions on Friday noon

items.explanation: 정답은 (C)예요. "contact Facilities Management at ext. 4400 by Wednesday afternoon"이 그대로 답이에요. 이메일이 아니라 내선 4400으로 전화, 기한은 수요일 오후.

items.stem: When will the updated timeline be provided IF additional work is needed?
items.explanation: "we will provide an updated timeline no later than Friday at noon" — no later than은 "늦어도 ~까지"라는 뜻이에요. (B) By Friday at noon이 정답.

passage.subject: Incomplete Sentences

items.stem: Ms. Rivera has _____ three cross-functional projects since joining the company.
items.explanation: (B) led가 현재완료 has 뒤의 과거분사 형태이므로 정답입니다.

items.stem: The hiring manager asked whether the candidate _____ available to start in September.
items.explanation: (B) was는 과거 동사 asked에 이어지는 간접의문문의 자연스러운 시제입니다.

items.stem: Applicants are encouraged _____ specific examples of measurable results.
items.explanation: (C) to provide가 encourage 목적격 보어의 수동형 be encouraged to do 구조를 완성합니다.

title: TOEIC Part 5 — 면접 어휘
subtitle: 비즈니스 면접 · 역량과 성과

body: Choose the word or phrase that best completes each sentence.
passage.subject: Incomplete Sentences

faq: 면접 답변에 이 표현을 써 주세요

items.stem: Her ability to resolve customer complaints demonstrates strong problem-solving _____.
items.explanation: (A) competency는 업무를 수행하는 역량을 뜻해 문맥에 가장 알맞습니다.

items.stem: The candidate _____ a 15 percent reduction in operating costs at his previous company.
items.explanation: (A) achieved는 구체적인 성과나 결과를 달성했다는 의미입니다.

items.stem: Please describe a situation in which you took the _____ to improve a process.
items.explanation: (A) initiative는 지시를 기다리지 않고 주도적으로 행동하는 태도를 뜻합니다.

title: TOEIC Part 5 — 면접 상황
subtitle: 비즈니스 면접 · 협업과 문제 해결

body: Choose the word or phrase that best completes each sentence.
passage.subject: Incomplete Sentences

faq: 이 문장을 자연스러운 면접 답변으로 확장해 주세요

items.stem: When priorities changed unexpectedly, the team quickly _____ its project schedule.
items.explanation: (B) adapted to가 목적어 its project schedule과 함께 쓰이는 올바른 표현입니다.

items.stem: A strong answer should explain the action taken _____ the result that followed.
items.explanation: (C) and가 action과 result라는 두 요소를 자연스럽게 연결합니다.

items.stem: Interviewers often value candidates who can remain _____ under pressure.
items.explanation: (C) composed는 remain 뒤에서 주어의 침착한 상태를 설명하는 형용사입니다.

title: TOEIC LC — 짧은 대화 · Set 1
subtitle: 회의 일정 조율

body.speaker: W
body.text: Do you have a minute? I'd like to move our weekly team meeting.

body.speaker: M
body.text: Sure. Is Tuesday afternoon still a problem for you?

body.speaker: W
body.text: It is. I have a client call that always runs long, so I keep joining late.

body.speaker: M
body.text: Then let's try Wednesday morning. Most people are in the office by nine.

body.speaker: W
body.text: That works for me. Could you send the updated agenda to everyone?

body.speaker: M
body.text: I'll do that this afternoon, right after I confirm the room.

faq: 이 대화의 핵심 표현을 정리해 주세요
move a meeting 과 reschedule 의 차이를 알려 주세요

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
items.explanation: 여자가 "I'd like to move our weekly team meeting"이라고 말하며 주간 회의 시간을 옮기자고 제안합니다. (B)가 정답.

items.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do?
items.explanation: 여자가 "Could you send the updated agenda to everyone?"이라고 요청합니다. (A)가 정답.

items.stem: When will the meeting most likely take place?
items.explanation: 남자가 "let's try Wednesday morning"을 제안하고 여자가 "That works for me"로 동의합니다. (C)가 정답.

title: TOEIC LC — 짧은 설명문 · Set 2
subtitle: 사내 공지 · 시스템 점검

body.speaker: M
body.text: Good morning, everyone. This is a brief announcement from the IT department.

body.speaker: M
body.text: Our expense reporting system will be unavailable this Saturday from eight a.m. to two p.m.

body.speaker: M
body.text: During that window, please submit any urgent receipts by email instead.

body.speaker: M
body.text: We expect the upgrade to make approvals about thirty percent faster.

body.speaker: M
body.text: If you have questions, the help desk will be staffed as usual on Monday.

faq: 공지에서 시간 표현을 다시 짚어 주세요
이 안내를 이메일로 바꿔 써 주세요

items.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.text: To remind staff about a deadline

items.explanation: "Our expense reporting system will be unavailable this Saturday"로 점검 안내임을 밝힙니다. (B)가 정답.

items.stem: What are listeners asked to do during the downtime?

options.text: Visit the help desk in person

items.explanation: "please submit any urgent receipts by email instead"라고 안내합니다. (A)가 정답.

items.stem: What benefit does the speaker mention?
items.explanation: "make approvals about thirty percent faster"로 승인 속도 향상을 언급합니다. (B)가 정답.
